title: Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast. We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped. Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm: a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships. What you'll actually do Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate \"we have this messy thing happening in our operations\" into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon. Architect the solution. On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time: \"Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\" You don't need to write the production code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy. Run the pod. Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review. Prototype when needed. You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build. Juggle. You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving. Who you are You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff. You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools. You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business. You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say \"that wasn't in the ticket.\" You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it. This role is for you if You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call. You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls. You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already. You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company. This role is not for you if You want to write production code all day. You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function. You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives. You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week. You avoid ambiguity. Location Fully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U. S. Eastern Time. How to apply To apply, please email (not DM) the following directly to and copy : Your resume A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally owned In the Loom, cover: The business problem you were solving Your specific role The technical workflow or architecture at a high level The biggest challenge you solved How you organized and managed delivery We strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

title: Data engineer iii
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data engineer iii em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Posição temporária! Visão Geral da Posição A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de desempenho do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de infraestrutura de dados escalável e soluções de engenharia. A equipe trabalha em estreita colaboração com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders do negócio para viabilizar acesso confiável a dados de alta qualidade, apoiar análises avançadas e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização. O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio. O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA. O que você fará Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis. Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes. Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados. Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas. Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos. Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização. Qualificações Mínimas • Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada. • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento de plataformas de dados ou funções relacionadas. • Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente). • Familiaridade com frameworks de big data e processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / Py Spark). • Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados. • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines. • Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake). • Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, qualidade de dados e governança de dados. • Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento. • Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos. • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos. • Inglês fluente. Qualificações Desejáveis • Experiência com arquiteturas de data lake e ambientes de dados híbridos. • Experiência com suporte a pipelines e infraestrutura de machine learning. • Experiência com aplicações de dados (ex.: Streamlit) e interfaces conversacionais (chatbots). • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA. • Experiência contribuindo para documentação e plataformas de compartilhamento de conhecimento (ex.: Confluence). • Experiência em organizações globais com estrutura matricial.

Líder Técnico de equipe de Sensoriamento Remonto (experiência de 3 com gestão de equipes) (local: Brasil/ home office – atuar na área de Inteligência Agro) O que você vai fazer? - Gestão técnica das frentes de sensoriamento remoto aplicadas à agricultura (monitoramento de safra, fenologia, detecção de mudança, uso e cobertura). - Definir critérios e padrões técnicos (metodologias, janelas temporais, máscaras, regras de evidência, validações e critérios de aceite). - Treinamento de equipes, revisões técnicas, suporte em decisões e resolução de problemas. - Desenvolver e manter automações e pipelines em Python para ganho de eficiência, escala e reusabilidade. - Validar a consistência e qualidade dos outputs (rastreabilidade, replicabilidade, evidências e documentação). - Priorizar e gerenciar backlog/demandas (Jira), garantindo previsibilidade de entregas. - Reunião com clientes e stakeholders. Qual a formação? - Graduação concluída em Engenharia Agronômica/Agrícola, Engenharia Florestal, Engenharia Ambiental, Geografia, e Engenharia Cartográfica. - Desejável Mestrado em Sensoriamento Remoto ou Geotecnologias ou Ciência de Dados. O que precisa ter para participar? - Forte vivência com agricultura (dinâmica de safra, sazonalidade, interpretação temporal). - Perfil proativo. - Sensoriamento remoto aplicado à agricultura: séries temporais, índices espectrais (NDVI/ EVI/ NDWI/ NDMI etc.), interpretação, classificação e validação. - Python para automação e análise. Como também Google Earth Engine (GEE) e ML aplicado (classificação, detecção de anomalias, avaliação de acurácia). - Organização/reprodutibilidade: documentação de critérios, evidências, versionamento de entregas. Indispensável: - Experiência mínima de 3 anos na liderança de equipes de sensoriamento remoto, para atuação com agricultura - Disponibilidade para atuação de segunda à sexta em horário comercial, atuação exclusiva neste contrato. title: Emerging market trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging market trader em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.) on markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

description:

Job Title: Video Creator / Creative Editor Location: 100% Remote Type: Contract Compensation: Retainer that reflects experience, seniority and skill level, + bonuses. Required Assessment: ─────────────────────────────── 916 Studios is a premium creative production company producing social-first content for brands, creators, agencies, and public companies. Our clients range from fast-scaling consumer brands to publicly listed companies, with projects including work for Google, Oracle and Tik Tok. ─────────────────────────────── THE ROLE: We're looking for a multi-disciplinary Video Creator / Creative Editor who doesn't wait to be told that something 'could be better'. Video Creators produce high-performance content for social media, website and beyond, blending strategy, editing, motion, sound, and narrative into media that drives results, (not just views). ─────────────────────────────── WHAT YOU'LL DO: Edit premium short & long-form content for Tik Tok, Instagram, You Tube, Linked In, and X Own projects end-to-end, from brief to final delivery Act as your own creative director, i.e. source, create, or generate every asset if needed, including: graphics, motion, sound, etc, to cohesively serve the story Build engaging hooks, retention and pacing Adapt creative styles intelligently to different brands and audiences Deliver strong first drafts ─────────────────────────────── COMPLETE THE ASSESSMENT AND APPLY IF YOU HAVE: 5+ years of professional editing experience A portfolio of social-first content that proves viewer-retention with links to work currently live on social media Advanced Premiere Pro + working After Effects so that you can build from scratch, (not reliant on templates) A strong sense of storytelling, with the ability to independently select and organise footage into a coherent, engaging narrative even without a provided script The ability to work efficiently under pressure and at speed without compromising quality Strong sense for design, photo editing, and branding A strong sound design, colour grading, and audio mixing ability A deep understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and platform-native editing Clean workflow habits: methodical, organised, no missed deadlines and excellent communication. ─────────────────────────────── WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE: You consistently deliver high-quality edits with meticulous attention to detail Your first cuts are robust and require minimal revision (if any!) IMPORTANT: Applications without a completed assessment will not be considered.

title: Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast. We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped. Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm: a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships. What you'll actually do Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate \"we have this messy thing happening in our operations\" into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon. Architect the solution. On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time: \"Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\" You don't need to write the production code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy. Run the pod. Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review. Prototype when needed. You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build. Juggle. You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving. Who you are You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff. You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools. You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business. You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say \"that wasn't in the ticket.\" You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it. This role is for you if You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call. You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls. You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already. You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company. This role is not for you if You want to write production code all day. You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function. You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives. You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week. You avoid ambiguity. Location Fully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U. S. Eastern Time. How to apply To apply, please email (not DM) the following directly to and copy : Your resume A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally owned In the Loom, cover: The business problem you were solving Your specific role The technical workflow or architecture at a high level The biggest challenge you solved How you organized and managed delivery We strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

title: Data engineer iii
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data engineer iii em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Posição temporária! Visão Geral da Posição A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de desempenho do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de infraestrutura de dados escalável e soluções de engenharia. A equipe trabalha em estreita colaboração com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders do negócio para viabilizar acesso confiável a dados de alta qualidade, apoiar análises avançadas e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização. O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio. O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA. O que você fará Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis. Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes. Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados. Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas. Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos. Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização. Qualificações Mínimas • Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada. • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento de plataformas de dados ou funções relacionadas. • Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente). • Familiaridade com frameworks de big data e processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / Py Spark). • Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados. • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines. • Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake). • Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, qualidade de dados e governança de dados. • Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento. • Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos. • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos. • Inglês fluente. Qualificações Desejáveis • Experiência com arquiteturas de data lake e ambientes de dados híbridos. • Experiência com suporte a pipelines e infraestrutura de machine learning. • Experiência com aplicações de dados (ex.: Streamlit) e interfaces conversacionais (chatbots). • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA. • Experiência contribuindo para documentação e plataformas de compartilhamento de conhecimento (ex.: Confluence). • Experiência em organizações globais com estrutura matricial.

description:

Líder Técnico de equipe de Sensoriamento Remonto (experiência de 3 com gestão de equipes) (local: Brasil/ home office – atuar na área de Inteligência Agro) O que você vai fazer? - Gestão técnica das frentes de sensoriamento remoto aplicadas à agricultura (monitoramento de safra, fenologia, detecção de mudança, uso e cobertura). - Definir critérios e padrões técnicos (metodologias, janelas temporais, máscaras, regras de evidência, validações e critérios de aceite). - Treinamento de equipes, revisões técnicas, suporte em decisões e resolução de problemas. - Desenvolver e manter automações e pipelines em Python para ganho de eficiência, escala e reusabilidade. - Validar a consistência e qualidade dos outputs (rastreabilidade, replicabilidade, evidências e documentação). - Priorizar e gerenciar backlog/demandas (Jira), garantindo previsibilidade de entregas. - Reunião com clientes e stakeholders. title: Paid ads qa auditor - global
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Paid ads qa auditor - global em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you obsessive about catching what others miss? Do you notice inconsistencies without being told where to look? Do you get satisfaction from identifying errors before they become problems? Final question: when faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away? If that sounds like you, you may be the perfect fit for our Paid Ads QA role. At Crisp, we're on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry. Our Paid Ads team is responsible for executing paid media campaigns that power our law firm clients' brand awareness and growth across major digital platforms. These campaigns are deployed across hundreds of client accounts and multiple platforms simultaneously. This role exists to ensure those campaigns are executed accurately, consistently, and in alignment with internal standards and client intent. This is a non-client-facing, audit-focused role that requires extreme attention to detail, strong system thinking, and the discipline to identify and document discrepancies with zero tolerance for preventable error. However, it is not a "task-ing" role, or a role where you'll be constantly told what to do - you'll be expected to self-sufficiently spot and correct errors, but most importantly, get ahead of them before even happening, including improving existing systems. ** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY ** You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions: Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first. Then reply to the ad, stating you've completed the Willo, and we will be in touch. Key Responsibilities Include: Campaign Audit & Validation Audit paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, Linked In, Tik Tok, streaming platforms, and others Verify that the correct creative assets, ad copy, and campaign structures are deployed on the correct client accounts Ensure campaigns align with intended funnel stages and approved execution parameters Execution Accuracy & Cross-Account Integrity Identify discrepancies such as: Incorrect assets deployed to the wrong client Mismatched ad copy or campaign configurations Inconsistent implementation across platforms Ensure campaign execution matches internal direction and client-specific setup Budget & Pacing Verification Audit campaign budgets to ensure alignment with approved allocations Identify risks of underdelivery or overspend Validate that budget adjustments and reallocations are executed correctly Tracking, Links & Technical QA Verify accuracy and functionality of: URLs and landing pages UTM parameters and tracking links Pixel and tag implementation (where applicable) Identify gaps in tracking integrity and flag inconsistencies Instruction Fidelity & Change Validation Compare campaign execution against: Internal strategy direction Client Success Manager requests Campaign updates or pivots Ensure requested changes are implemented accurately and completely Audit Documentation & Communication Document audit findings clearly, with supporting context and evidence Categorize issues based on severity (e.g., minor discrepancy vs. critical error) Communicate findings in a structured format that enables efficient resolution Audit Operations (Evolving Scope) This role may operate across a range of audit models depending on business needs, including: Audit Cadence: Pre-launch validation Post-launch verification Ongoing daily, weekly, or periodic audits Audit Coverage: Full account audits Targeted sampling across accounts Audit Depth: Surface-level validation (assets, placements, links) Deeper audits (budget pacing, tracking, structural accuracy) Ownership Scope: Identifying and flagging discrepancies Recommending corrective actions Supporting enforcement of quality standards Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must: Be highly detail-oriented — you catch inconsistencies others miss Think in structured processes, checklists, and systems Be proactive in identifying issues and asking clarifying questions Be comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgments Have strong written communication skills Be tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment Preferred Experience: Experience auditing or QA-ing digital campaigns (launches, changes, tracking) Familiarity with UTM structures, tracking links, and link verification Experience working with dashboards or reporting tools Experience using project management or task tracking tools (Asana, Monday, etc.) Nice to Have: Salesforce or CRM familiarity Experience with Supermetrics or similar data connectors Familiarity with Google Looker Studio or similar dashboards Experience documenting processes or building SOPs Experience in a fast-paced, multi-client environment Platform Exposure (Preferred, Not Required): Meta Ads Manager Google Ads Google Tag Manager (GTM) Tik Tok Ads Linked In Ads Trade Desk Why Our Work Matters: Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn't teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, legal expertise alone isn't enough. That's where Crisp comes in. We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it's a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors. Our work levels the playing field by giving law firms access to world-class marketing execution that helps them stand out, build authority, and grow sustainably. About Crisp: Crisp has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 (Fastest Growing Private Companies in the U. S. – 2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017), as well as Atlanta's Top 100 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) and Atlanta's Best Places to Work (2024, 2023, 2022). Crisp () is the nation's fastest-growing law firm growth company. We've helped thousands of attorneys — from solo and small firms to large practices — build their brand, differentiate themselves from competitors, attract better cases, and earn millions in new revenue. Crisp has been featured in Forbes, Inc., Avvo, ABA Journal, The Trial Lawyer, Huffington Post, and The Wall Street Journal. OUR BOOK: The Game Changing Attorney (available on Amazon and Barnes & Noble) OUR PODCAST: The Game Changing Attorney Podcast Why You Should Work Here: You will work inside a structured, high-performance marketing operation You will contribute to campaigns running at scale across hundreds of accounts You will play a direct role in improving execution accuracy and system reliability You will be trusted to identify and surface critical issues This is not a role for someone looking for easy work or vague expectations. This is a role for someone who takes pride in enforcing standards, identifying errors, and ensuring systems operate correctly. ** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY ** You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions: Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first. Then reply to the ad, stating you've completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.

description:

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. title: Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai implementation lead (technical pm for agents & agentic / automated systems) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast. We are hiring an AI Implementation Lead to own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped. Think of this as a principal-level role at a consulting firm: a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships. What you'll actually do Own the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate \"we have this messy thing happening in our operations\" into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon. Architect the solution. On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time: \"Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\" You don't need to write the production code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy. Run the pod. Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review. Prototype when needed. You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build. Juggle. You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving. Who you are You have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff. You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools. You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business. You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say \"that wasn't in the ticket.\" You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it. This role is for you if You can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call. You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls. You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already. You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company. This role is not for you if You want to write production code all day. You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function. You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives. You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week. You avoid ambiguity. Location Fully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U. S. Eastern Time. How to apply To apply, please email (not DM) the following directly to and copy : Your resume A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally owned In the Loom, cover: The business problem you were solving Your specific role The technical workflow or architecture at a high level The biggest challenge you solved How you organized and managed delivery We strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

title: Fund operations analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fund operations analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The RoleWe're looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Fund Operations Analyst with 1 to 3 years of experience to join our team in São Paulo. This is a critical role in our firm's infrastructure, demanding both technical rigor and strong operational ownership.You will be a key member of our back-office team, working directly with the CFO and senior partners to ensure the efficiency, compliance, and scalability of our fund's operations. You will own the \"engine room\" of an international investment fund — managing offshore structures, investor relations, financial controls, and regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions.This role offers significant exposure to the full lifecycle of a growth-stage VC fund and direct interaction with world-class financial service providers.Key Responsibilities· Financial Management & Treasury — Own day-to-day treasury operations for both local (CNPJs) and offshore entities, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow management, FX operations, and bank reconciliations.· Fund Administration Management — Manage the relationship with external stakeholders of the fund's US entities, including Fund Administrators, legal counsel, tax advisors, and external auditors (Big 4).· Investor Relations (IR) Operations — Execute Capital Calls, Distributions, and NAV calculations. Lead LP onboarding (KYC/AML) and serve as the primary point of contact for investor inquiries and reporting.· Financial Reporting & Close — Lead monthly and quarterly close in coordination with external accountants. Review the fund's financial statements for accuracy and compliance (US GAAP / IFRS).· Legal & Governance — Review fund documents (agreements, side letters, subscription docs) and maintain the Data Room to ensure audit readiness at all times.· Fundraising Operations Support — Support capital raising processes, including Data Room management, LP due diligence coordination, and subscription document processing.· Process Improvement — Continuously identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and implement scalable processes and tools across the fund's back-office.Requirements· 1–3 years of experience in Fund Operations, Fund Administration, Audit (Big 4 or similar), or Corporate Finance / Treasury at a financial institution, investment fund, or large corporation.· Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.· Exceptional organizational skills and precision in financial data management.· Advanced proficiency in Excel.· Ability to interpret financial statements, understand fund accounting principles, and flag risks proactively.· Ownership mentality — ability to manage multiple workflows autonomously and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.

title: Cloud engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

My client, a US Software Company, with offices in Brazil, is seeking seeks a motivated individual to join their Cloud Services team as a Cloud Engineer. This role supports and maintains their cloud environments and Dev Ops processes in a mixed cloud environment while collaborating with senior engineers on infrastructure improvements and architecture decisions. The position involves implementing and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (Ia C). Primary Job Duties: Work in an issue and project tracking system to document task details and track time. Support and maintain the current cloud environment, infrastructure resources, applications, and project work. Monitor cloud environment health and performance, troubleshoot and resolve issues. Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues with minimal supervision. Design and maintain scalable Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules and structured patterns for multi-environment or multi-account deployments, with strong practices for state management and version-controlled workflows Collaborate with senior engineers on cloud architecture and design. Maintain environment security using industry best practices and established policies and procedures. Support Dev Ops practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues. Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks. Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices. Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure automation, monitoring, deployment workflows, and cost savings. Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis. Improve system reliability through automation and observability. Qualifications Required Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are required for the Cloud Engineer II role. Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration. Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS. Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows. Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools. Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.g., Git). Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar. Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly. title: Spanish or portuguese expert for ai training & evaluation
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Spanish or portuguese expert for ai training & evaluation em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're building a curated network of Spanish-speaking and Portuguese-speaking language professionals from Latin America to participate in AI training and evaluation projects with leading AI platforms, research labs, and data companies. This opportunity is ideal for translators, linguists, language professionals, bilingual communicators, and detail-oriented speakers interested in flexible, remote AI-related work. Candidates may apply with expertise in either Spanish OR Portuguese — proficiency in both languages is NOT required. Prior AI experience is NOT required. Unlike traditional full-time roles, these projects are task-based and platform-dependent. Work availability, compensation, and project duration may vary over time. About the Role Selected candidates may be guided through onboarding processes for AI training platforms working with multilingual datasets, language evaluation workflows, speech and text annotation, localization tasks, and AI-generated content review. Typical tasks may include: • Reviewing, evaluating, and improving AI-generated text or speech outputs in Spanish or Portuguese • Identifying linguistic inconsistencies, grammar issues, localization errors, or cultural nuances • Supporting multilingual evaluation, annotation, transcription, translation, or content quality workflows Projects are generally flexible and remote, allowing contributors to work independently on their own schedules. Who We're Looking For We're primarily looking for: • Spanish or Portuguese speakers • Translators • Linguists • Language teachers • Localization specialists • Editors and proofreaders • Communication or humanities students/professionals Preferred qualifications: • Strong written communication skills • Excellent grammar and attention to detail • Solid English comprehension • Experience in translation, editing, localization, or language-related work • Ability to identify tone, nuance, and linguistic inconsistencies • Familiarity with AI, language tools, or annotation platforms is a plus, but not required Important Transparency About the Process Vintti AI is NOT the company directly hiring for these projects. Our role is to identify and represent high-potential LATAM language talent, help candidates navigate onboarding and platform assessments, and share opportunities that may fit their backgrounds. We do not control platform acceptance decisions, project availability, task allocation, or future earnings. Compensation Compensation varies depending on the platform, the project, task complexity and contributor performance. Current market rates for language-related AI projects may range approximately between: USD 20–95/hour, depending on expertise, language specialization, and assignment type. These projects are generally best suited as flexible remote work, freelance income or an additional professional revenue stream, rather than a guaranteed full-time position. Vintti AI Representation Model This model helps support onboarding guidance, candidate support, project navigation and future access to additional AI-related opportunities. Full details are discussed transparently before any formal commitment. Why This Is Interesting AI companies increasingly need human language expertise — not just general annotators. Spanish and Portuguese speakers are becoming essential for training AI systems capable of multilingual communication, localization and translation, speech recognition, cultural adaptation, content evaluation and natural language understanding. This is an opportunity to participate directly in the development of next-generation AI systems while working remotely and flexibly.

title: Specialist ai engineer / builder (llm & healthcare) | remote job
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Specialist ai engineer / builder (llm & healthcare) | remote job em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Challenge Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI. We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale. Why This Role Might Be for You Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn. You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate. Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build. Key Responsibilities Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities. Today: Execution and Precision Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance. Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable. Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously. Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases. Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer. Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage. What We're Looking For Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required. Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company. Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as Open AI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock. Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact. What We Offer Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture. High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI. Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful. Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil. Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us. Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company's story.

title: Líder técnico de equipe de sensoriamento remonto
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Líder técnico de equipe de sensoriamento remonto em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Líder Técnico de equipe de Sensoriamento Remonto (experiência de 3 com gestão de equipes) (local: Brasil/ home office – atuar na área de Inteligência Agro) O que você vai fazer? - Gestão técnica das frentes de sensoriamento remoto aplicadas à agricultura (monitoramento de safra, fenologia, detecção de mudança, uso e cobertura). - Definir critérios e padrões técnicos (metodologias, janelas temporais, máscaras, regras de evidência, validações e critérios de aceite). - Treinamento de equipes, revisões técnicas, suporte em decisões e resolução de problemas. - Desenvolver e manter automações e pipelines em Python para ganho de eficiência, escala e reusabilidade. - Validar a consistência e qualidade dos outputs (rastreabilidade, replicabilidade, evidências e documentação). - Priorizar e gerenciar backlog/demandas (Jira), garantindo previsibilidade de entregas. - Reunião com clientes e stakeholders. Qual a formação? - Graduação concluída em Engenharia Agronômica/Agrícola, Engenharia Florestal, Engenharia Ambiental, Geografia, e Engenharia Cartográfica. - Desejável Mestrado em Sensoriamento Remoto ou Geotecnologias ou Ciência de Dados. O que precisa ter para participar? - Forte vivência com agricultura (dinâmica de safra, sazonalidade, interpretação temporal). - Perfil proativo. - Sensoriamento remoto aplicado à agricultura: séries temporais, índices espectrais (NDVI/ EVI/ NDWI/ NDMI etc.), interpretação, classificação e validação. - Python para automação e análise. Como também Google Earth Engine (GEE) e ML aplicado (classificação, detecção de anomalias, avaliação de acurácia). - Organização/reprodutibilidade: documentação de critérios, evidências, versionamento de entregas. Indispensável: - Experiência mínima de 3 anos na liderança de equipes de sensoriamento remoto, para atuação com agricultura - Disponibilidade para atuação de segunda à sexta em horário comercial, atuação exclusiva neste contrato. title: Senior golang engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior golang engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are hiring on behalf of our client, a global leader in the meal kit delivery industry that helps millions of customers cook healthy, homemade meals without the stress of meal planning or grocery shopping. As part of Zoolatech's distributed engineering team, you will join the Market Innovation team - a fast-moving internal innovation group focused on building and delivering new product initiatives across multiple domains and services. Unlike traditional product teams, this team operates across different repositories, architectures, and backend ecosystems, taking ownership of complex discovery-driven projects from investigation to MVP delivery. By joining Zoolatech, you will work closely with senior engineering leadership and global stakeholders in a highly autonomous environment that values ownership, adaptability, strong communication, and engineering curiosity. Responsibilities Investigate and understand existing backend services and distributed systems Design and implement backend solutions primarily using Golang Work on MVP delivery from technical discovery through implementation Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders across multiple domains and teams Communicate technical findings and proposed solutions clearly Adapt quickly to new codebases, services, and technologies Contribute to scalable and maintainable backend architecture Skills Required Strong commercial experience with Golang Strong background in backend development, microservices, and distributed systems Experience building event-driven architectures using messaging technologies such as Kafka, Rabbit MQ, or AWS SQS/SNS Solid understanding of testing practices, including unit and end-to-end testing Strong knowledge of relational databases Ability to quickly understand and navigate unfamiliar codebases and services Strong problem-solving and backend investigation skills Good communication skills and ability to work independently English level sufficient for direct communication with international teams Nice to Have Experience with Python Familiarity with Mongo DB, Elasticsearch, Graph QL, or JVM languages Experience working in fast-paced MVP or startup-like environments Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully) This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider. To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country. Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

title: Personal trainers — capte novos alunos através dos desafios do acadenutri
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Personal trainers — capte novos alunos através dos desafios do acadenutri em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga Se você é personal trainer e quer aumentar sua base de alunos, essa oportunidade é para você. O Acadenutri é uma plataforma que conecta profissionais de educação física a pessoas que estão buscando acompanhamento, treino e melhora da qualidade de vida. Como funciona: • Centenas de pessoas entram na plataforma por meio dos nossos desafios de 7 e 14 dias, aumentando a demanda por acompanhamento profissional. • Os profissionais parceiros do Acadenutri podem captar novos alunos através desses desafios e monetizar diretamente seus atendimentos. • Além das ferramentas de acompanhamento profissional, os profissionais recebem acesso completo às ferramentas da plataforma: — aplicativo para alunos — sistema administrativo para anamneses, avaliações físicas, criação de treinos e gestão de atendimentos — acompanhamento de treinos — recursos de atendimento e organização • Para participar da plataforma, é necessário possuir uma assinatura ativa do Acadenutri. Após a ativação, os profissionais recebem acesso à comunidade oficial dos desafios para networking, suporte e oportunidades de atendimento. • Profissionais com plano anual participam dos desafios sem custo adicional. Modelo: Modelo de atuação baseado em autonomia profissional e atendimentos independentes através da plataforma. Para quem é: • Personal trainers que querem mais alunos • Profissionais com perfil proativo • Interesse em atendimento online ou presencial Como fazer parte: • Baixar o aplicativo Acadenutri • Criar seu perfil profissional • Completar seu perfil profissional na plataforma Buscamos profissionais comprometidos, humanizados e interessados em crescer junto com a plataforma. Se você acredita que treino vai além da estética e pode transformar vidas, queremos conhecer você. O Acadenutri está construindo uma rede integrada entre saúde, treino e acompanhamento profissional personalizado. Estamos expandindo nossa rede de profissionais parceiros neste momento.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bookkeeper em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We've intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work. At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive. We're now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ, this is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You'll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support. What You'll Do Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close. Maintain accurate financial data using Quick Books or other cloud-based accounting tools. Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions. Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace. Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, and timelines. Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency. Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes. Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core's quality expectations. What We're Looking For Fluent in English Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time) Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools. Nice to Have Experience with Asana and Everhour or any other workflow automation tools Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana Prior experience working with startups or small businesses Why You'll Love Working With Us At Aerial Core, we do things differently: Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload. Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we'll support it. Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success. Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You'll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained. The Aerial Core Way Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value. Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights. Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth. Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care. Ready to do accounting differently? Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Senior software engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior software engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Context We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past few months, achieving 5x revenue growth in the last 12 months and a 10x increase in usage over the same period. As we continue on this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to support our rapidly scaling infrastructure and ensure we can meet the demands of our ever-growing user base. Mission As a Full-Stack Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize scalable applications. You will own features end-to-end and work closely with stakeholders to take ideas from concept to release, maintain & scale. This role demands a hands-on approach, strong motivation, and a drive to seek the best solutions while maintaining high-quality standards. Key Responsibilities Own Features from 0 to 1: Take complete ownership of features, collaborating with your teammates and stakeholders to define requirements, design solutions, and deliver them to production. Ensure every detail is addressed through to the finish line. Scalable Infrastructure: Collaborate with infrastructure teams to design systems that efficiently handle increasing traffic and usage. Build and Scale Applications: Develop and maintain scalable, high-quality features and applications. Ensure Code Quality by Promoting the adoption of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and maintaining high standards for reliability and maintainability. Integrations Between Frontend and Backend: Design and build systems that simplify and enhance integrations between front-end and back-end applications, enabling seamless communication and efficient data exchange. Support Collaboration: Partner with the support team to diagnose and resolve complex issues, improving tools and processes to enhance the customer experience. Observability and Monitoring: Strengthen our observability by integrating and improving tools that provide insights into application health and performance. Whom Are We looking For We seek a Senior Software Engineer who thrives in high-growth environments and combines technical expertise with relentless motivation. You'll take pride in building scalable systems, owning features end-to-end, and delivering user value. Key Qualifications Node.js, Type Script & React Expertise: Extensive experience with Node JS, TS, & React, leveraging modern development patterns and best practices. Event-Driven Architecture: Proven experience building event-driven systems using tools like message brokers or similar technologies. TDD Focus: Commitment to Test-Driven Development (TDD) and a strong track record of delivering high-quality code. Scalable Applications: Experience designing and maintaining systems that perform under heavy traffic and scale with user demand. Monitoring Tools: Proficiency with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) for monitoring and maintaining system health. Ownership Mindset: Demonstrated ability to take ownership of features, from initial design through production release. Ultra-motivated and Hands-On: Eager to dive into the code and solve challenging problems with enthusiasm and focus. Seek the Best Solutions: Continuously evaluate and implement the best tools, technologies, and methodologies to solve problems effectively and innovate within the team. Thrives in Chaos: Ability to embrace and adapt to the fast-paced, dynamic environment of a high-scaling startup, maintaining focus and effectiveness amidst ambiguity. Bonus Qualifications Media Processing: Experience with video and audio processing, streaming technologies, or related workloads. AI Integration: Worked with artificial intelligence systems or tools, either integrating AI features into applications or ensuring smooth collaboration with AI-based solutions. Start-Up Experience: Prior experience working at a fast-growing, large-scale startup is a strong plus. Diverse Technical Knowledge: A valuable asset is familiarity with additional programming languages, design patterns, or architectural paradigms.

Suportar os processos de gestão, controle e análise das verbas comerciais, assegurando correta alocação, execução e mensuração de retorno (ROI). Monitorar impactos das ações comerciais nos resultados, margens e indicadores financeiros. Analisar e consolidar informações de vendas, custos e despesas, garantindo aderência ao planejado. Produzir relatórios gerenciais de resultados e desempenho financeiro, com análises críticas e recomendações executivas. Realizar apresentações e reuniões com áreas internas para demonstração de resultados, análises financeiras e orçamentárias. Analisar e liberar requisições de compra, conforme políticas internas e orçamento aprovado. Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos demais membros da equipe de Controladoria, disseminando boas práticas. Executar suas atividades em conformidade com normas técnicas, procedimentos internos, políticas de qualidade, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente. Realizar outras atividades correlatas, compatíveis com o cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato. Requisitos: Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA. Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados. Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado. Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will
